description.zh:
账号备注信息，备注信息需满足如下要求：
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
* 长度为2~256个字符。
description.en:
The description of the account. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length.

description.zh: 该参数用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间该参数值的唯一性。该参数区分大小写、长度不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

title.zh: 修改边缘集群账号备注信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-account-description-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000 --account-name testacc --account-description testdes --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountDescriptionZonal --region cn-hangzhou --AccountDescription testdes --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000' --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --AccountName testacc
